sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Experience
Machine Learning Engineer Intel
July 2021 - Present Bangalore, India
1. Targeted Detector – Threat Detection Technology
Designed, trained, and deployed ML models for real-time detection of cyber threats using CPU telemetry .
Built scalable feature engineering pipelines to transform high-volume telemetry data into model-ready signals, improving detection robustness.
Performed extensive model evaluation and tuning using ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, F1-score, confusion matrix analysis, and threshold/false-positive optimization to balance detection accuracy and reliability.
Optimized model performance through hyperparameter tuning and algorithm selection, leading to improved detection accuracy in production environments.
Trained and evaluated models using AWS EC2, managed datasets on S3, and tracked experiments with DVC to ensure reproducible and well-organized research results.
Worked closely with security researchers and platform teams to translate threat research into deployable ML solutions.
2. AI-Based Telemetry Selector
Enhanced existing telemetry selection algorithms to better identify high-value features for security modeling, reducing data collection overhead and improving model efficiency.
Applied continuous learning techniques to adapt telemetry selection strategies as new attack patterns emerged.
Built data processing pipelines to collect, clean, and aggregate telemetry across multiple hardware platforms.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate solutions into existing security frameworks.
Software Development Intern Intel
Jan 2021 – Jun 2021 Bangalore, India
Designed and implemented multiple Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate algorithmic, architectural, and code-level optimizations for performance-critical systems.
Benchmarked alternative approaches and identified performance bottlenecks, leading to measurable improvements in efficiency and system throughput.
Collaborated closely with R&D Team to validate and integrate successful POCs into existing development workflows.
Worked with production-grade codebases, gaining hands-on experience in version control, debugging, and performance analysis.

• Published the experimental findings in a research paper on arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07746.
